name: Carrying Rig
description: A harness and side pouches. Your hands hold 12 at a time instead of 6. Crates stay the size they were.

name: Delivery Harness
description: Proper webbing and a waist belt. Six more in your hands again, so eighteen at a time. Crates stay the size they were.

name: Shoulder Yoke
description: A yoke across the shoulders with a crate hook either side. Twenty-four in your hands — two full boards in one trip from the bay.

name: Good Boots
description: Move 30% faster. Feels enormous once the shop gets big.

name: Trail Runners
description: Half again as fast as bare feet. Replaces the boots rather than stacking with them — the quickest pair you own is the pair you walk in.

name: Warehouse Skates
description: Wheels on your heels. Nearly twice walking pace, which is the difference between a shop you run and a shop you commute across.

name: High Street Frontage
description: Move onto the high street. Twice the people walk past, and they were going shopping anyway.

name: Market Square
description: A corner on the square. Everyone in town crosses it at least once a week.

name: Retail Park Unit
description: Out of town, off the ring road. Nobody walks past, so lay some tarmac and a few parking bays before you move.

name: Till Supplier
description: A deal on registers. Every till you install costs 25% less.

name: Register Trade Account
description: Buy registers at trade. 40% off every till you install, and it replaces the earlier deal rather than stacking with it.

name: New Shopfront
description: Timber frontage, deep window bays and a lit stall out front. Adds to the repaint rather than replacing it.

name: Repaint and Signage
description: New paint, a proper hanging sign and a swept forecourt. Nothing to place: the shop just looks like somewhere doing well, and word gets about.

name: Cold Chain Deal
description: The refrigeration people know you now. 20% off every freezer you build. Ice cream money.

name: Cold Chain Account
description: A trade line with the refrigeration supplier. 35% off every freezer you build, and it replaces the earlier deal rather than stacking with it.

name: 24-Hour Licence
description: The doors never have to shut. Night footfall is about a tenth of the evening rush, so it pays out slowly, and only while somebody is on the till.

name: Late Licence
description: Trade until midnight. The evening rush is long over by then, so expect a trickle. Worth it if somebody is on the till anyway.

name: Groundwork Deal
description: A standing order with the timber yard for bed frames and topsoil. 20% off every raised bed you build from here on.

name: Growers Account
description: Buying frames by the pallet. 35% off every bed you dig, and it replaces the standing order rather than stacking with it.

name: Shelving Contract
description: A standing order with the shopfitter. Every shelf you build from now on is 15% cheaper.

name: Shopfitters Account
description: Buy shelving at trade. 30% off every shelf you put down, and it replaces the standing order rather than stacking with it.

name: East Paddock
description: Three more columns of land down the east flank. Nothing is built for you and nothing you built moves. Ground to wall, floor, farm and pave.

name: South Paddock
description: Three more rows of land toward the street. The building stays put. Room for an annex, a longer drive or another block of beds.

name: North Paddock
description: Three more rows behind the shop, where the yard is. The world slides south to make room and everything you built goes with it.

name: West Paddock
description: Three more columns down the west flank. The world slides east to make room and everything you built goes with it.

name: Back Field
description: Five more rows behind the North Paddock. Room for a proper yard, a second dock or a stockroom out of sight of the street.

name: The Back Forty
description: Twenty more rows behind the Back Field. Enough to move the whole shop and still have a yard. The last land on the map.

name: Hire a Chef
description: Works the appliances: gathers ingredients, makes the products, shelves them.

name: Hire a Clerk
description: Mans the till and takes payment so shoppers stop walking out of the queue.

name: Hire a Farmhand
description: Plants, harvests and walks the produce to a shelf.

name: Hire a Shop Hand
description: Tills, deliveries and shelves. Picks the odd ripe bed when the shop is quiet.

name: Hire a Stocker
description: Buys wholesale and keeps the shelves full while you are out back.

name: Blast Freezer
description: Freezes anything you put in it, hard and fast. Peas, berries, chips, lollies, fish fingers, and this morning’s pizza.

name: Blender
description: Turns produce into salsa and smoothies.

name: Butcher's Block
description: A block, a saw and a mincer. Whole birds become portions, beef becomes mince, and pork becomes bacon and sausages.

name: Candy Kettle
description: A copper kettle for boiling sugar. Gummies, liquorice and chocolate slabs. The town asks for candy more than almost anything.

name: Churn
description: Separates and works milk into cream, butter and curds. Twenty minutes of curds in a preserving pot makes a cheese wheel worth eight times the milk.

name: Coffee Machine
description: Beans and milk in, a proper flat white out. Cocoa makes hot chocolate, which wants a hot counter rather than a shelf.

name: Deep Fryer
description: A basket and a vat of hot oil. Doughnuts out of your own wheat and eggs, and hot chips out of oven chips. The chips want a hot counter.

name: Grill
description: A flat-top grill. Skewers for the shelf, and roast chicken, carvery, hot dogs and bacon rolls for a hot counter.

name: Juicer
description: A press with a jug under it. Tomatoes and carrots off your own beds go in, garden juice and ketchup come out, worth several times the veg.

name: Mill
description: Stone rollers. Your own wheat becomes flour and your own beet becomes sugar. Most of the kitchen starts here.

name: Mixer
description: A dough hook and a bowl. Flour and eggs in, dough, pastry, batter and fresh pasta out. The middle step of most baking.

name: Oven
description: A proper deck oven. Wheat off your fields becomes bread worth four times the sheaf. Also tarts, and mince pies in winter.

name: Preserving Pot
description: A copper pot and a rack of jars. Turns a glut off the fields into pickles and chutney that keep for a year.

name: Sandwich Press
description: A hinged plate that toasts both sides at once. Bread and a filling, out in a minute. The cheapest way to turn two shelf items into a better one.

name: Soft-Serve Machine
description: A chilled hopper and a lever. Milk with berries or jam comes out as swirls and lollies. All of it needs a freezer.

name: Stock Pot
description: A deep pot over a burner. Tins, dried pasta and a bit of mince become soup and ready meals. The soup wants a hot counter, the pasta bake a freezer.

name: Toaster Oven
description: Bakes and toasts. Bread in, better bread out.

name: Hot Counter Deal
description: Heat lamps and gantries at trade price. 20% off every hot counter you build.

name: Servery Fit-Out
description: The whole servery run, bought as one job. 35% off every hot counter.
